note: _nollet eam traducere_ – he did not wish to hand her over (to the sight of the people). Here _traducere_ is an abbreviated form of the idiom _traducere per ora hominum_ – to hand over to public view (as in Livy: _Ab urbe condita_ II, 38). – Jacob Arnold Hagen: _Sprachliche Erörterungen zur Vulgata_. Freiburg 1863 (iv, 106 pp.), p. 63.

_donec peperit filium_ [_suum primogenitum_] (Weber/Gryson, Clementina) – until she would give birth to [her firstborn] son. The Nova Vulgata omits the two words set between brackets because they are not in the modern standard editions of the Greek text.
